stop_rule: Do not stop on elapsed time, packet count, thread count, or agent/subagent limit. Stop acquisition for an axis only after two later live continuation families of different kinds, queries, and artifacts add no material decision value after its last material addition, or after supported route-bounded source exhaustion establishes the weaker claim ceiling.
claim_ceiling: This is a pre-seal acquisition-routing scan. It identifies what remains to be tested and does not award corroboration, prevalence, causation, decision maturity, material saturation, or delivery readiness.
